title: Do Job Applicants Consider Founder Race and Gender? Evidence from a Field Experiment

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables 4-5 (application and salary request by founder-race/gender condition)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: randomized field experiment; logit/probit/OLS on condition dummies with city FE; cross-sectional, not DiD

eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. Job seekers are randomized to three founder-demographics conditions; outcomes are application and requested salary, estimated with logit, probit and OLS on condition dummies. Two survey experiments follow.
design_notes: KSPY-Shared.do runs logit dv_a i.Condition i.city i.initial_position ... cluster(city), and reg annual_salary i.Condition ...
data_files_note: De-identified experimental data shipped; some variables are coarsened codings for anonymity (do-file header).
data_provenance_note: Authors' experimental data, de-identified and partly coarsened.
screener_notes: Published text confirms field experiment. Not a near miss.
